objections.test: control-demand proxy cannot auto-become controller state
objections.challenge: Feature/Contextual/Temporal Control regressors could be treated as internal controller variables.
objections.finding: They are task-demand conditions/regressors; source DCM models how regional dynamics are modulated by them.

objections.test: neural correlate cannot auto-become CTL mechanism
objections.challenge: Regional activation or an LPFC label could be promoted to generic control operator.
objections.finding: Only source-estimated directed effective-connectivity relations are retained as model operators; activation alone is not.

objections.test: fitted latent variable mistaken for persistent cognitive state
objections.challenge: DCM hidden state/connectivity estimates might be treated as learned persistent coordinator state.
objections.finding: They are states/parameters of a fitted neural dynamics model; model inversion occurs at analysis level, not within-agent learning.

objections.challenge: Winning revised DCM could be reported as uniquely identified by current sample.
objections.finding: Current-sample 913-model search left 19 similarly plausible candidates; prior-sample adjudication was used. Nonuniqueness must remain explicit.

objections.challenge: Causal test might be summarized as simple confirmation of prior DCM.
objections.finding: Unexpected caudal/SFS effect on Temporal Control contradicted the original model and triggered revision; Stage A retains it.

objections.challenge: Earlier trait cognitive-ability association could be carried forward.
objections.finding: Source did not reproduce that association; it remains adverse evidence.

objections.challenge: Best tested DCM might be generalized to globally best architecture.
objections.finding: Source allows unexamined modulations to fit better; conclusion is bounded to tested model spaces.

objections.test: model revision mistaken for cognitive learning
objections.challenge: Scientific model-space refinement could be mapped as an online learner update.
objections.finding: Revision/model selection is analyst-level chronology and not an in-agent learning rule.

source_ordered_omission_sweep.result: prior DCM and causal-test purpose retained.
external intervention and unexpected Temporal-Control effect retained.
913/19 nonuniqueness and cross-sample selection boundary retained.
trait-association nonreplication and bounded causal interpretation retained.
